attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to require new user passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least 3 character classes, via pam_pwquality (libpam-pwquality) wired into /etc/pam.d/common-password with minlen=12, minclass=3, enforce_for_root in /etc/security/pwquality.conf. Verified enforcement pre- and post-reboot with weak/compliant password attempts, then restarted node1 and confirmed boot identity changed and policy persisted.
